items.text_th: บัค. คือนี่มาย้ายเสริฟไม่ทันต้องปั้นใหม่แต่ไม่ติดตรงนั้นแต่คือสร้างไอดีใหม่แล้วตอนออกแล้วเข้าเกมมันต้องล็อคอินซ้ำและเป็นแบบนี้ทุกรอบที่ออกเกม แถมทำเควสกดใจให้โปรไฟล์คนอื่นก็ไม่ได้ด้วย ผิดหวังมากกะว่าจะเติมซื้อชุดไปแล้วตอนแรกดีนะลองเล่นไปก่อน
items.text_vn: Lỗi. Mình không kịp chuyển server nên phải cày lại từ đầu, cái đó không sao, nhưng tạo ID mới rồi mà mỗi lần thoát ra vào lại game là phải đăng nhập lại, lần nào cũng vậy. Thêm nữa làm nhiệm vụ thả tim cho hồ sơ người khác cũng không được. Thất vọng lắm, định nạp mua bộ đồ rồi, may mà lúc đầu chơi thử trước.
items.summary_vn: Mỗi lần vào game phải đăng nhập lại, nhiệm vụ thả tim lỗi.
items.text_en: Buggy. I didn't transfer servers in time so I had to grind from scratch, that's fine, but after making a new ID, every time I exit and reopen the game I have to log in again, every single time. Also the quest to send hearts to other people's profiles doesn't work. Really disappointed, I was about to top up to buy an outfit, good thing I tried it out first.
items.summary_en: Has to log in every time they open the game, and the heart-sending quest is bugged.

items.theme: Tương tác xã hội tiêu cực

items.text_en: Run. Tons of hackers, the team can't fix anything, the game is all bugs bugs bugs, items are hard to get, so stingy.
items.summary_en: Lots of hackers and bugs, items hard to get.
